displayName: ExportMate AI service: assistant answers failing

documentation.content:
Three or more assistant answers in an hour ended other than ok (error, max_steps, needs_review). `npm run ops -- --days=1` lists why; each audit is in Firestore `audits`.

Logs Explorer, project ${PROJECT_ID}: `resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="${SERVICE}" AND jsonPayload.message="chat.completed" AND jsonPayload.status!="ok"`

conditions.displayName: Answers not ok in an hour
